title: Allow user to customize timezone (time zone) names
line: Time zones in the Digital Clock can now be renamed, so Chicago can show up as Houston.
explanation: The Digital Clock could only label a time zone by its code, its IANA city or its UTC offset, so anyone tracking a place that isn't the zone's namesake city (Houston in America/Chicago) had to remember the mapping. The Time Zones settings page now has a rename button on every configured zone that opens a small dialog; the name is stored per zone in a new customTimeZoneNames entry and is shown instead of the code, city or offset in the panel, the tooltip and the popup. Leaving the field empty goes back to the default label.

commits.message:
applets/digital-clock: allow giving time zones custom names

Time zones could only be shown by their code, city or offset, so users
had to remember that "Chicago" meant Houston. Each configured time zone
can now be renamed, and the name is shown in the panel, tooltip and popup.

BUG: 395164
